name: Arimura Romi
source:
She suddenly appears and steals the school's top spot from Shuuta.
She doesn't usually show up to school.
She's a girl with lots of mystery about her.
She continues to publish cutting-edge scientific papers on the net.
She instructs Shuuta to form the Scientific Investigation Club.

[Translated from the [url=https://glovety.product.co.jp/]official site[/url]]

[spoiler]Previous name: Himura Akane (比村 茜)[/spoiler]
